dogecoin.text:
6. The Meme Marketing King 👑

Elon Musk is the first billionaire who uses memes to market billion-dollar companies.
---
In 2021, he tweeted this meme 👇

"Dogecoin is the people's crypto"

Result?
Dogecoin went from ₹0.40 to ₹70 in one month.

No ad campaigns. No partnerships.

5. The Distraction Game 🔥

Whenever Tesla faces bad news...
Musk changes the topic with viral tweets.

Example:
👉 Tesla car crashes → Musk tweets about Mars
👉 Autopilot lawsuits → Musk tweets about Dogecoin
👉 Stock dropping → Musk smokes weed on Joe Rogan podcast.

4. Cryptocurrency Pump & Dump 💸

Elon Musk made millions without creating a single crypto coin.

All he did was tweet:
👉 "Doge to the moon"
👉 "Bitcoin is good"
👉 "Bitcoin is bad"

---

Result?
✅ Dogecoin +800%
✅ Bitcoin $1 TRILLION market cap
✅ Crypto market crash
